summary: Order-service placement 500s are caused by bad deployment dep-5101 (v2.14.0, deployed 12:10Z), which added a new MarginCheckValidator to the order validation chain for F&O orders. Starting 12:12:31Z (first error, ~2 min post-deploy) it throws 'NullPointerException: marginProfile is null' for orderType=FNO, rejecting orders with HTTP 500. Error rate jumped from ~0.2% to ~18.3% at the 12:12 bucket and persisted. No pre-deploy occurrences of this error exist, and CPU, DB pool, latency, request rate and the pricing-engine error rate are all flat, ruling out resource, capacity, infra and dependency causes. Fix is to roll back dep-5101 or hotfix the null-margin handling.

ranked_hypotheses.title: dep-5101 bad deployment: new MarginCheckValidator NPEs on F&O orders
ranked_hypotheses.statement: order-service v2.14.0 (dep-5101, 12:10Z) introduced MarginCheckValidator into the validation chain and removed legacy OrderRules.validateMargin(); the new validator dereferences a null marginProfile for FNO orders, throwing NullPointerException and rejecting the order with HTTP 500. The fault originates in the order-service code release.

causal_chain.claim: dep-5101 deployed order-service v2.14.0 at 12:10Z adding MarginCheckValidator
First MarginCheckValidator NPE occurs at 12:12:31Z, ~2 min after deploy, with no prior occurrence in days of logs
Error rate jumps from ~0.2% to ~18.3% in the same 12:12 bucket
All errors are NullPointerException: marginProfile is null, exclusively for orderType=FNO, i.e. the exact new F&O path
No resource, latency, pool, downstream or shared-component anomaly accompanies onset, so the fault is in the new code path, not the environment

assumptions: The validation chain change shipped atomically with v2.14.0 (change summary explicitly lists the new validator)
marginProfile was previously populated/skipped by the removed legacy validateMargin() so only the new path fails

ranked_hypotheses.title: F&O accounts lack margin profile data (data_issue)
ranked_hypotheses.statement: The marginProfile records for FNO accounts are missing/not provisioned, so any consumer, including the new validator, would see null; the deploy only exposed a pre-existing data gap.

causal_chain.claim: marginProfile is null for many distinct accounts in the error logs

assumptions: Margin data is stored externally and could be absent rather than simply unread by the new code path
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: If margin data were broadly missing, the removed legacy OrderRules.validateMargin() would have failed on the same orders before 12:10. There are zero marginProfile errors before the deploy (F5) and the failure set is exactly the new validator's code path (F4). Timing localized to the deploy, not to a data-load event; no data/ETL change appears in config changes (F10).

ranked_hypotheses.title: Resource/dependency/infra fault (pool, downstream, shared DB)
ranked_hypotheses.statement: A resource exhaustion, capacity, credential or downstream dependency failure caused order-service 500s.

causal_chain.claim: Downstream or datastore degradation propagates 500s to order placement
But CPU, pool, latency, request rate and pricing-engine error rate are all flat

assumptions: A shared component could fail without visible telemetry
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: All resource and dependency metrics are flat through onset (F6-F9); the errors are a deterministic NPE with a specific null field, not timeouts/connection errors (F2); pricing-engine, portfolio-service and ledger-db show no errors (F9, F11, F12).

facts.statement: order-service error rate rose from ~0.2% to ~18.3% at the 12:12 bucket and stayed elevated.
All 426 order-service errors are marginProfile-null NPEs in MarginCheckValidator, first at 12:12:31Z, all orderType=FNO.
dep-5101 deployed order-service v2.14.0 at 12:10Z adding MarginCheckValidator and removing legacy OrderRules.validateMargin(); not rolled back.
No occurrences of the marginProfile error exist before the deploy.
order-service CPU (~40%), db pool (~14 conns), latency p99 (~150 ms) and request rate (~232 req/s) are flat across onset.
Downstream pricing-engine error rate stayed flat at ~0.22%.
The only other change in the window was an unrelated notification-service email batch-size config tweak.

assumptions: The change summary 'new MarginCheckValidator in validation chain' shipped atomically with v2.14.0.
marginProfile was handled safely by the removed legacy validateMargin(), so failures began only with the new code path.

timeline.event: Baseline: order-service error rate ~0.2%, CPU ~40%, pool ~14, p99 ~150ms, req ~232/s
dep-5101 deploys order-service v2.14.0 adding MarginCheckValidator for F&O orders
First 'NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate line 88 orderType=FNO' logged

Incident INC-001 reported by on-call SRE
Error rate still ~18.75% avg; fault persists, deployment not rolled back

recommended_actions.action: Roll back dep-5101 (order-service v2.14.0) to the last known-good version immediately to restore order placement.
recommended_actions.rationale: Onset coincides with the deploy and every failure is in the new validator's code path; rollback is the fastest recovery.

recommended_actions.action: If rollback is not possible, hotfix MarginCheckValidator.validate to null-guard marginProfile (or restore legacy OrderRules.validateMargin()) and ship as a patch.
recommended_actions.rationale: The NPE is a straightforward null dereference on marginProfile for FNO orders.

recommended_actions.action: Audit why marginProfile is null for FNO orders and whether the removed legacy path populated/skipped it, to avoid regressions on re-enable.
recommended_actions.rationale: Determines whether the new path needs a data fallback or the margin source needs fixing.

recommended_actions.action: Add a canary/error-rate gate and unit tests covering FNO margin validation before validation-chain changes reach 100% of traffic.
recommended_actions.rationale: A 2-minute ramp to ~18% error rate should have been caught by progressive delivery.

data_gaps: No raw stack trace or source line context beyond 'MarginCheckValidator.java:88'; the exact null source (missing record vs. unpopulated field) is not directly observable from logs alone.
No telemetry from exchange-api (external, has_telemetry=false), though no evidence points there.
order-service logs were truncated (426 matched, 30/20 returned); pattern counts were still complete, so the FNO-only scope is supported but per-account coverage is sampled.

findings.statement: order-service error rate jumped sharply at the 12:12 bucket: from ~0.2% baseline (11:00-12:00 buckets) to 18.33% avg at 12:12 and remains ~18-19% through 13:48.
First ERROR log in order-service is at 12:12:31Z; all 426 errors in the window match two patterns referencing MarginCheckValidator and 'marginProfile is null', both first-seen at 12:12.

findings.statement: Every logged exception carries orderType=FNO; the two patterns account for 224 + 202 of 426 errors.

Deployment dep-5101 to order-service v2.14.0 went live at 12:10:00Z with summary 'Refactor order validation; add margin check for F&O orders', adding 'new MarginCheckValidator in validation chain' and removing 'legacy OrderRules.validateMargin()'. Not rolled back.

No occurrence of the marginProfile/MarginCheckValidator error exists before the deploy: a log query covering 2026-03-01 to 12:12 returned total_matched=0, and a 00:00-12:15 query shows the first match at 12:12:31Z, after dep-5101.
order-service CPU stayed flat (~40% avg, max 43.44) across the whole window, showing no resource pressure coincident with onset.
DB connection pool usage stayed flat (~14 connections avg, max 15.24) across the window; no pool exhaustion.
order-service latency p99 stayed flat (~150 ms mean, max 164.98) across onset; request rate stayed flat (~232 req/s). This is a hard-failure pattern, not a saturation/latency pattern.
Downstream pricing-engine error rate stayed flat at ~0.22% throughout the incident window; no downstream dependency degraded.

Only two deployments occurred in the window: dep-5088 portfolio-service v4.2.1 (09:36, dependency bumps, live) and dep-5101 order-service v2.14.0 (12:10). The single config change was cfg-2101 on notification-service (email.batch_size 200->250 at 11:21), unrelated to order placement.
portfolio-service logged only 2 WARN entries (slow /internal/metrics request, deprecated TLS cipher) and no errors across the window.

order-service dependency map: it calls ledger-db, pricing-engine, exchange-gateway and kafka; ledger-db is a shared postgres. No shared-component or external-provider failure signal appeared in logs or metrics.
